# netactuate_metal (Resource)

Manages a Metal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_metal" "example" {
  device_id = 12345
  hostname  = "example.netactuate.local"
  profile   = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) Device ID
- `hostname` (String) Hostname assigned to the server.
- `profile` (Number) Profile ID

### Optional

- `build_script` (String) Build script content
- `disklayout` (Number) Disk layout ID
- `location` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `location_id` (Number) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Sensitive value sent to the NetActuate API.
- `ssh_key` (String) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.
- `ssh_key_id` (Number) SSH key ID assigned by the API.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `primary_ipv4` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `primary_ipv6` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_metal.example 12345
```
